```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;

  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"data_extraction":true,"language":"psv"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('a|b|c\n1|2|3\n', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.data);
    stdout.writeln(result.data?.kind);
    stdout.writeln(result.data?.children);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
```
